background_column_meaning: Unmatched detections counted by the archived implementation
counts_recording_method: Transcribed from the supplied unnormalized confusion-matrix image
implementation_note: Archived 8.0.201 logic: unmatched predictions are counted only if at least one IoU match exists; the shown validator skips confusion-matrix prediction updates on images without ground-truth labels.
record_origin: Historical representative-matrix record; integer counts transcribed from archived source images; existing framework and matrix settings retained; not a new inference run
validation_conf_role: Passed framework argument; RTDETRValidator.postprocess does not use it to filter evaluation queries
postprocessing_iou_role: Passed framework argument; RTDETRValidator.postprocess does not perform NMS or use this IoU argument
max_det_role: Passed framework argument; RTDETRValidator.postprocess does not truncate evaluation queries with it; released decoder configurations use 300 queries; also used to limit candidates sent to prediction plots
effective_matrix_selection: ConfusionMatrix.process_batch selects detections with confidence > confusion_matrix_conf and matches pairs with IoU > confusion_matrix_iou
